status: INCONCLUSIVE; functional FAIL (both arms failed calibration, no test inference)
question: Can a calibrated binary verification gate on the classifier's chosen label bring wrong reuse below 2% while retaining at least 19 correct matches?

hypotheses.H1: At least one verifier arm (nli or clef) meets every functional gate on the 140 saved test cases.
hypotheses.H0: No verifier arm meets every gate.

decision_rule: An arm passing all gates becomes the candidate mechanism for a later production design proposal. If no arm passes, stop and do not propose another prompt or model change from this evidence. Validity stays INCONCLUSIVE because the reference is AI-authored and previously inspected.

stats.interval: Exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound on wrong reuse among accepted reuses, computed by standard-library summation.
stats.test_for_h1: Per-arm gate evaluation with counts and rates. No significance test.

gates.name: integrity
gates.pass_when: All pinned input hashes verified; both thresholds frozen from development calibration before test inference; every preserved-files entry unchanged after the run.

gates.name: completeness
gates.pass_when: All 140 baseline cases classified per arm as accepted reuse, review or error, with none_fit pass-through accounted for.

gates.name: safety
gates.pass_when: Accepted reuses E > 0 and unrounded W/E < 0.02 among accepted reuses.

gates.name: retention
gates.pass_when: At least 19 correct accepted existing-label matches (C >= 19).

gates.name: review_load
gates.pass_when: Routed plus error cases at most 70% of 140.

baseline.proposer: Experiment 06 saved Qwen3-0.6B answers; no fresh proposer calls

clef_verifier.model: Clef-Flash-Q8_0 with the Experiment 03-pinned llama.cpp build
clef_verifier.pins_source: Experiment 03 recorded run manifest; re-verified at implementation; drift requires an amendment
clef_verifier.request: temperature 0, fixed seed when supported, native choice probabilities over yes and no

pair_construction.nli_premise: observation description verbatim after <private> stripping and secret check
pair_construction.nli_hypothesis: The primary requirement of this observation is to <definition, first letter lowercased, trailing full stop>
pair_construction.clef_question: Does this category definition describe the observation's primary requirement? Answer yes or no.

calibration.split: development; 60 positive cases, no none_fit cases
calibration.selection_rule: smallest grid threshold with wrong accepts at most 2% of accepted dev pairs and at least 45 of 60 positives retained
calibration.failure_handling: an arm with no qualifying threshold fails calibration and does not run on test
calibration.known_risk: dev negatives are same-section definitions, not proposer near-neighbour wrong picks; thresholds may be optimistic on dev

accept_rules.nli: argmax label is entailment and P(entailment) >= frozen tau_nli
accept_rules.routing: failed verification routes to review; never auto-none_fit; verifier errors route to review and count as errors
